title: Big Dutchman AG Appoints New Board Member | The Poultry Site
content: **GERMANY - Sven Guericke from Oldenburg has been appointed Member of the Board of Management of Big Dutchman AG. As of October 1, 2005, the 48-year-old graduate of agricultural engineering will be responsible for the areas of production coordination and logistics at the world market leader for feeding and housing equipment.**. Sven Guericke has a lot of experience in the agricultural and food industry. Furthermore, the new BD logistics board member has been a very committed honorary supporter of the agriculture and food business in Lower Saxony and especially the Weser-Ems region. The Board of Management of Big Dutchman AG is now composed as follows: Bernd Meerpohl (Sales & Development), Uwe Heider (Sales & Marketing), Kai Wehmeyer (Finance, IT & Administration) and Sven Guericke (Coordination of Production & Logistics). For many years now, Big Dutchman AG has been regarded as world market leader in the development and distribution of housing equipment and feeding systems for modern pig and poultry management.

title: Hellmann at IPPE 2026: German Engineering and Innovation
content: ## From IPPE 2026 in Atlanta, AviNews International sits down with Karl Bernd Fangmann, Managing Director of Hellmann Poultry, one of the leading global players in poultry equipment. * In this interview, we explore the key milestones that have shaped Hellmann Poultry into a worldwide reference, what truly sets its German-engineered, high-quality equipment apart, and how this “Made in Germany” commitment translates into real value, efficiency, and reliability for poultry producers. It’s not only the employees in our company, it’s also the partners we have in the individual countries, because at the end we need to be close to our customers and this is something we can only achieve if we have good partners in each and every country. **As a European company with a strong international presence, how do you see the future of Hellmann Poultry in the US and LATAM markets, and what is your long-term vision for growth and collaboration in these regions?**.
